title: FuelFlow / Logs
description: Log volume and search across the API and JobsWorker. Logs reach Loki through the in-app Serilog sink, which ships every line to the authenticated loki-gateway; nothing scrapes container output. Only service/environment/level are stream labels - everything else is a structured field, so filter with | json rather than adding labels (see docs/OBSERVABILITY.md (private docs repo)). The Background jobs panel is the job trail: every Hangfire run writes one line at the level of its outcome, so a failure can be read here long after the counter that recorded it has aged out.

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: A sudden change in shape is usually easier to spot than any single line. Sustained error growth here should correlate with the HighServerErrorRate alert.

panels.title: Errors in range
panels.description: Counts error-level lines only. Zero here while the app is clearly failing usually means the process is not shipping to Loki - check Observability:Loki:Enabled.

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Server-side trouble only: error-level lines plus warnings that are not a client's own 4xx. Request-completion lines for 4xx live in the panel below, because a stale app build asking for a route that no longer exists can produce hundreds of them an hour and bury the one line that matters. Expand a line to see TraceId/SpanId, which are attached as structured metadata so a log can be tied back to its request without becoming a high-cardinality label.

panels.title: Client errors (4xx)
panels.description: Requests the API refused or could not match to a route: expired sessions, stale clients, consumers reading a resource that is gone. Kept out of the panel above so they cannot hide a 5xx - but still worth a glance, because a burst that starts at one moment names the client version that broke.

panels.title: Background jobs
panels.description: Every finished Hangfire run: Information when it completed, Warning when it was cancelled, Error when it failed with the exception attached. JobType, JobName and DurationMs are JSON body fields, so isolate one job with | json | JobName="...". A failure here survives the counter that recorded it - which is the point, because Hangfire's retries clear the failed state in its own dashboard long before the log ages out.

panels.title: All logs
panels.description: Unfiltered stream for the selected services. Use the Search variable for a case-insensitive substring match across the raw line.
